svg.title: Side effects: retatrutide vs Ozempic 2 mg
svg.desc: Side effects: retatrutide vs Ozempic 2 mg. Diarrhea: Retatrutide 9 mg 28.3%, Retatrutide 12 mg 32.7%, Ozempic 2 mg 26.4%. Nausea: Retatrutide 9 mg 21.2%, Retatrutide 12 mg 23.8%, Ozempic 2 mg 21.3%. Constipation: Retatrutide 9 mg 14.2%, Retatrutide 12 mg 13.1%, Ozempic 2 mg 19.8%. Vomiting: Retatrutide 9 mg 10.2%, Retatrutide 12 mg 15.0%, Ozempic 2 mg 13.2%. Dyspepsia: Retatrutide 9 mg 10.4%, Retatrutide 12 mg 8.5%, Ozempic 2 mg 11.6%. Dysesthesia: Retatrutide 9 mg 4.8%, Retatrutide 12 mg 6.5%, Ozempic 2 mg 2.7%. Stopped for side effects: Retatrutide 9 mg 4.8%, Retatrutide 12 mg 7.9%, Ozempic 2 mg 2.7%.
